name: CFGNorm pre_cfg mode (norm-scaled CFG)
plain: A second, separate behaviour inside the same node. It works on the noise-side difference, replaces the CFG line, and can raise as well as lower magnitude. The tooltip says it matches models like Lens.
math:
c = x−x̂_c, u = x−x̂_u, m = u + s·(c−u)
r = ‖c‖₂,dim=1 / max(‖m‖₂,dim=1, 1e-12), or 1 if ‖m‖ = 0
f = strength·m·r + (1−strength)·m; x̂ = x − f

providers.author: AbstractEyes
providers.note: Default mode 'match' (with strength blend) is this entry's formula; mode 'attenuate' gives cfg-norm-core's clamped form. Default space eps (velocity on flow).

claims.text: matches norm-scaled CFG used by Lens
claims.label: from pack README claim

label: from code
surprise: Despite the name pre_cfg, it installs a sampler_cfg_function, not a pre-CFG hook.
